notes.title: Truck Driver - Patch 1.35.1 Has been Released!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!
 
[b]Truck Driver - Patch 1.35.1[/b] for Steam version is finally here! In this update, we've added Hidden Places and Truck Damage DLC to the base game, and fixed a bunch of bugs. We hope you enjoy these changes and have an even better time playing Truck Driver! 

Thank you for being so patient with us, we know how long you've been waiting for a new update. We assure you that more updates will come your way soon! So stay tuned!

Check out the full patch notes here:

[list]
[*] Added the hidden places and Truck damage DLC as a feature to the base game.
[/list]
Existing Issues fixed:
[list]
[*] fixed unwanted invisible colliders, present in multiple areas of the map.
[*] fixed UI speed limit value to match the speed limit of road signs.
[*] made a general fix for truck teleporting issues, this includes resetting truck after major crashes, resetting after the fuel tank is completely empty, resetting after falling asleep.
[*] made a general fix for trailer spawning issues for all the missions.
[*] made a fix for the trailer not spawning after resetting the truck or game or starting the job again.
[*] made a fix for the truck trailer spawning in a different place than intended at Maryie's missions.
[*] general collider fixes for more realistic behavior.
[*] general visual asset fixes and bug fixes.
[/list]


Once again, thank you for your continued support!

-Shemiah

FIXED: Balanced the speed traps according to the most recent speed limitations
FIXED: Resolved an issue with a failed mission upon entering a drop off area

Also, if you've missed our live stream of the upcoming map DLC 'Heading North', make sure to check it out here: [url=https://youtu.be/XnhKWBv_az4]https://youtu.be/XnhKWBv_az4[/url]

notes.title: Steering wheel fixes, multi-monitor fixes, DLC content fix - Update v1.32
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The latest update for Truck Driver just dropped! v1.32 is focused on fixes for steering wheel compatibility, as well as issues with multi-monitor and panoramic modes and more! Find the full patch notes right here:

[list]
[*]NEW: Added a default button to the steering wheels to change the camera
[*]NEW: Multi-monitor mode will only be enabled when multiple monitors are connected
[*]NEW: Revisited keyboard and steering wheel fluidity when both are connected

[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where mission steps were skipped when dialogue was skipped
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where the Quest Endurance LH8X6 could not reach 100% while parking
[*]FIXED: Fixed an issue where steering wheel button icons displayed incorrectly in GUI
[*]FIXED: Fixed an issue where rain would disappear in several camera modes
[*]FIXED: Fixed an issue where the RPM gauge was constantly hitting the limiter and not shifting up in automatic transmission trucks
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where steering wheels position would not reflect the in-game steering wheel
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where there was no force feedback and vibration on Logitech steering wheels
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where the Hidden Places & Damage System DLC content did not show up in-game
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where the camera got flipped while using Tobii Eye tracker
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where the panoramic view didn’t properly align between screens	
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue with borderless windowed mode
[/list]

Of course there's still some issues that you've reported to us that we're still working on like truck acceleration, some invisible walls with parking missions and more, but please stay tuned for the next update for that!

Have a great weekend!

-Marten

notes.title: New content, AI revisits, Improved driving feel - Update v1.31
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just published a new update for Truck Driver: v1.31! This update focuses on adding more content in the form of the 'Parking Missions' side activities

[list]
[*]NEW: Added ‘Parking Missions’ for all clients. In these new side missions, the client will ask the player to rearrange and move 1 to 4 trailers within the client’s locale. This new type of missions can be repeated every 20 minutes for every client
[*]NEW: Revisited and changed speed limits on all roads in the game to be more logical and realistic
[*]NEW: Revised all engines in all trucks and adjusted steering
[*]NEW: Improved visuals for AI vehicle lane switching
[*]NEW: Improved suspension feel in in-cabin camera modes
[*]NEW: Made visual upgrades to windscreens and sunscreens
[*]NEW: Revisited the way required parking position of trailers is displayed for a clearer indication
[*]NEW: Added a ‘completed missions’ list for all clients
[*]NEW: Added the ‘garage’ & ‘truck damage and repair’ mechanics to the game’s tutorial
[*]NEW: Added profile pictures to conversations with clients
[*]NEW: Added Social media buttons to the main menu that link to the corresponding pages

[*]FIXED: Removed a bug where the speed limit would drop to 30 km/h on junctions
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where players would be fined for running red light while light is still orange
[*]FIXED: Fixed an issue where AI Traffic would drive with constant braking lights lit
[*]FIXED: Tweaked the turning radius for 6x4 & 8x4 trucks
[*]FIXED: Removed floating pieces of road in several areas
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where players’ satnav would display wrong starting location when entering and leaving a garage during a mission
[*]FIXED: Removed incorrect signs near T-junctions
[*]FIXED: Removed wrongly placed 75 km/h signs in specific areas
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where certain languages in the menu weren’t displayed correctly
[*]FIXED: Overhauled all city/town signs on highways
[*]FIXED: Resolved an issue where AI traffic drove relatively close to each other and formed trains
[/list]
So, there's quite a lot in here that will alter the main experience as well. Driving the truck should feel different, the AI behaves differently as well and all speed limits have been revisited. Feedback is very important to us, especially in updates like this! So please let me know what your experience is with v1.31 through the Steam Community Hub, or join our Discord server at https://discord.gg/soedesco

Have fun!

-Marten

notes.title: First hotfix is here! - v1.30
notes.content:
Hey all!

First of all, thank you for all your feedback over the past week since launch. It's given us a lot of insights on how the game could still be improved, and luckily a lot of those things were already in the works! The next proper update will be v1.31, and will include improvements for AI behavior, revisited speed limits and new content in the form of parking missions! More on that later. For now, a quick hotfix for some issues with button mapping on steering wheels, sound effects in-cabin and multi monitor panoramic mode. Here's the patch notes!

[list][*]Fixed: Steering Wheels; Button mapping is now displayed correctly in the menus
[*]Fixed: Steering Wheels; Button mapping is now displayed correctly during the tutorial
[*]Fixed: Steering Wheels; Button mapping is now displayed correctly within other UI elements
[*]Fixed: Normalized crash sounds when in in-cabin camera perspective
[*]Fixed: Correctly alligned multi monitor panoramic mode in in-cabin camera perspective
[*]Fixed: Credits have been updated[/list]
Have a great weekend, and see you soon for v1.31!

-Marten

Here's another Truck Driver dev update. The Hidden Places & Damage System DLC is a free content pack that includes the following:

notes.title: Truck Driver Patch notes - Update 1-4
notes.content:
Hi all!

Today I just wanted to give you the full patch notes of patch 1, 2, 3 and 4 that we've done for Truck Driver on PS4 and Xbox One! Of course, all of these points are also benefitting the PC release of the game, so that's why I'm posting them here as well.

[b]Patch #1[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Force Feedback for the Logitech G920 steering wheel
[*]Increased braking effectiveness when using the Logitech G920 pedals
[*]Fixed random traffic jams caused by the white van
[*]Fixed an issue where waypoints wouldn't show up when you're not on the road
[*]Fixed an issue where cruise control would turn off after going in the menus
[*]Tweaked the 'green time' of traffic lights
[*]Tweaked the ‘skilled driver’ skill, so it should be easier to level up
[*]Tweaked the Refrigerated -and Container cargo skill, so it should be easeir to level up
[*]Tweaked David Sung’s time trial missions (needs further tweaking and will be done in a next patch)
[*]Fixed flipped image issues with Quest truck mirrors
[/list]

[b]Patch #2[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a scalable HUD to prevent the UI to be cut off
[*]Solved Clipping issues of the steering wheel and chassis of the Quest trucks
[*]Weather effects have been tweaked, it will now rain more often in the game
[*]Added a ‘low fuel’ warning when you’re almost out of fuel
[*]Added an “abandon current job” option in the menus
[*]You now have to turn off your engine before refueling
[/list]

[b]Patch #3[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a peeking feature to look left or right instantly using Dpad (controller + steering wheel) Note: this doesn’t work on the PlayStation 4 Dualshock 4 controller yet, but it does work on PS4 steering wheels.
[*]Tweaked David Sung timed missions (increased time)
[*]Fixed bug where route doesn’t show up on satnav in missions for Iona Funar
[*]Rebalanced weather conditions (Rain occurs less often)
[*]Fixed rain clipping through roof of cabin in cockpit view
[*]Fixed issues with steering wheel sensitivity and force feedback
[*]Fixed inaccurate speedometer in cockpit view of multiple trucks
[*]Fixed headlight and high beam indicator in cockpit view
[*]Fixed visual bug when driving under tunnels/bridges in top-down camera view
[*]Fixed texture issues in gas stations
[*]Fixed issue where you could get stuck in tutorial
[*]You can now exit the game during character selection
[*]Updated localization for certain languages
[/list]

[b]Patch #4[/b]
[list]
[*]The peeking feature (tap + hold D-pad left or right) has been improved and now feels a lot smoother and quicker
[*]You can now use the peeking feature on a Dualshock 4 controller for PlayStation 4
[*]Added peeking feature to controller + steering wheel overview in menu
[*]Added controller vibration on engine ignition
[*]You can now switch the HUD mirrors on and off individually in the menu
[*]Implemented RateMyApp on Xbox One consoles
[*]Fixed a bug where steering your truck was locked for a duration of time when in the ‘Mission Failed’ screen
[*]You now have to turn off your truck’s engine before sleeping at a rest stop
[/list]

So! Up until now these are the patches we've published for Truck Driver. Before you ask, we don't have any further news on the PC version yet. I can only tell you that all that we do to the game now, also benefits the PC version when it eventually comes out.

Seeya!

-Marten
